# Terramorph LLC

> Landscape design and build company in Perrysburg, Ohio, serving homes and businesses across Wood and Lucas County (Greater Toledo): paver patios and hardscapes, drainage solutions, landscape design and installation, outdoor lighting, lawn maintenance, seasonal cleanups, and snow removal. Founded by brothers Ty and Trent Lincoln. 4.9 stars from more than 220 Google reviews. BBB accredited. Free estimates.

## Service area
Perrysburg, Toledo, Maumee, Sylvania, Bowling Green, Rossford, Oregon, Waterville, Whitehouse, Holland, Ottawa Hills, Monclova, and the rest of Wood County and Lucas County, Ohio.

## Services
- [Landscape Design](https://terramorphllc.com/landscape-design.html): Terramorph designs and installs landscapes for homes and businesses in Perrysburg, Toledo, Maumee, Sylvania, and across Wood and Lucas County, Ohio. You see the plan first: beds, plants picked for clay soil and your sun, edging, rock or mulch, and drainage checked before anything is planted. The same crew then installs it. Estimates are free.
- [Paver Patios and Hardscapes](https://terramorphllc.com/paver-patios-hardscapes.html): Terramorph builds paver patios, walkways, fire pit areas, steps, and retaining walls across Wood and Lucas County, Ohio. Every patio starts below the surface with excavation, a compacted base, drainage planning, and solid edge restraint, so the pavers stay flat through Northwest Ohio freeze-thaw winters. The layout is planned around how you will use the space. Estimates are free.
- [Drainage Solutions](https://terramorphllc.com/drainage-solutions.html): Terramorph fixes standing water, soggy lawns, and runoff for homes in Perrysburg, Toledo, Maumee, and across Wood and Lucas County, Ohio. We find where the water comes from first, then move it with grading, buried downspouts, French drains, catch basins, or dry creek beds, depending on the yard. Clay soil and flat lots are the usual causes here. Estimates are free.
- [Outdoor Lighting](https://terramorphllc.com/outdoor-lighting.html): Terramorph designs and installs low-voltage outdoor lighting for paths, entries, patios, driveways, and trees across Wood and Lucas County, Ohio. Lighting is planned around how you move through the yard at night and what you want seen from the street. It can be added to an existing landscape or built into a new patio or bed. Estimates are free.
- [Lawn Maintenance](https://terramorphllc.com/lawn-maintenance.html): Terramorph provides recurring lawn maintenance for homes and businesses in Perrysburg, Toledo, and across Wood and Lucas County, Ohio: mowing, edging, trimming, weeding, and bed upkeep on a set schedule. The same crew can handle fall core aeration and overseeding, spring and fall cleanups, mulch refreshes, and snow removal. Estimates are free.
- [Seasonal Cleanups](https://terramorphllc.com/seasonal-cleanups.html): Terramorph does fall and spring cleanups across Wood and Lucas County, Ohio. A fall cleanup clears leaves from the lawn, beds, and fence lines and hauls them away, cuts back perennials, shapes shrubs, cleans up bed edges, and finishes the lawn before winter. Commercial blowers and full crews handle big wooded lots. Estimates are free.
- [Snow Removal](https://terramorphllc.com/snow-removal.html): Terramorph provides snow removal for homes and businesses in Perrysburg, Toledo, and across Wood and Lucas County, Ohio: plowed driveways, cleared walkways and entries, commercial lots, and salting for ice. Booking before the first storm gets the property covered for the season. Estimates are free.
